title: U.S. Army drones to hunt mines and FPV threats before Abrams tanks arrive
summary: “We are honored to be awarded by the U.S. Army our first prime contract, a major milestone for SPAI that reflects our team’s relentless work and dedication to
body_markdown:
By


[Emily Ryan Miller](https://defence-blog.com/author/emily/)


Key Points


- The U.S. Army awarded Safe Pro Group a $2.5 million prime contract to run its explosive-detection software on Anduril’s Ghost-X drones to protect Abrams tanks.
- The software scans live drone video for more than 150 threat types and sends locations into ATAK and Anduril’s Lattice.
